regions.today: A cool and breezy evening with sunny spells and scattered showers, in moderate to fresh northwesterly winds.
regions.tonight: Showers will die away early on and the rest of the night will be dry with long clear spells. Cloud will begin to thicken from the west towards morning. Lowest temperatures of 3 to 7 degrees in a light westerly breeze.
regions.tomorrow: It will be a dry start to tomorrow, Thursday, with some sunny spells. Cloud will build during the morning, with rain and drizzle spreading from the west and becoming widespread in the afternoon. The rain and drizzle will continue through the rest of the day. Highest temperatures of 13 to 15 degrees with light to moderate southwesterly winds freshening with the arrival of the rain.
